title: React Admin — plan-time crystallization
stack: React 19 · Vite · TypeScript · Tailwind v4 + shadcn · TanStack Router/Query · MSW v2 · Playwright + axe · orchestrator + scout and mechanic sub-agents (models per experiment)
about: Same task as workbench 02 — identical base app, entities, tiers, and batch schedule — so its sweeps serve as historical baselines. Both arms run the SAME autonomous light harness (plan → build → verify, HARNESS.md): an orchestrator writes a plan artifact before any code, delegates mechanical implementation to mechanic sub-agents, and closes the four gates itself. The only experimental variable is a plan directive present in the with-schematics arm — a crystallization lifecycle: schematics are EXTRACTED from proven, gates-green implementations, never invented ahead of them. Established pattern repeating ≥3 times → extract the schematic from the proven instance before building the repeats; pattern not yet established → hand-build the first instance, prove it, declare it the rule, extract once green; schematic falls short → extend-vs-new is decided at the next plan. Every decision is persisted in the plan file for post-hoc audit.
proves: That the win is the CRITERION, not the artifact. Workbench 02 showed blanket batch-1 schematization never amortizes (+48% cost, zero quality gain on the leveled sweep). If deciding WHERE to schematize at plan time beats it — a cheaper batch 1 than blanket schematics, an earlier cost crossover against the manual arm, and lower inter-batch variance — then the value of schematics lives in planning-time judgment over foreseeable repetition, and standardization is something you decide, not something you default to.

experiments.title: Plan-time crystallization
experiments.hypothesis: Deciding at plan time where to extract a schematic ends batch 5 below the manual arm's cumulative cost, at the same quality.
experiments.variable: A plan directive in the with-schematics arm: extract a schematic from proven code once a pattern repeats three or more times; both arms run the same plan → build → verify harness.
